docs.title: Benign Reference Document on Citation Grounding
docs.text:
TITLE: Benign Reference Document on Citation Grounding
AUTHORS: Fixture Author
ARXIV: n/a   PUBLISHED: 2026-01-01   CATEGORY: cs.CL

Abstract
Grounded citation requires every generated statement to be traceable to a source span. A verifier compares each atomic claim against retrieved evidence spans and rejects claims that lack support. Verification coverage is reported per claim.

Method
We retrieve candidate evidence spans with a lexical ranking function. Each candidate is scored by weighted concept coverage and by numeric consistency with the claim. Claims whose coverage falls below a fixed threshold are marked as insufficient and are not emitted.
